Ex - 2 The average of 9 numbers is 40. If the average of the first five numbers is 38 and the average of the last five numbers is 50, then what is the fifth number? Sol : The average of 9 numbers is 40. Total = 40 * 9 = 360. Average of the first five numbers is 38. Total = 38 * 5 = 190. Average of the last five numbers is 50. Total = 5 * 50 = 250. Fifth number = 190 + 250 - 360 = 440 - 360 = 80. Ex - 3 10 years ago, a father’s age was 3 1 2 times that of his son and 10 years from now, the father’s age will be times 2 1 4 that of the son.
